title: Karim — Le projet qui dort dans son téléphone
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Karim
character.description: Karim, a 29-year-old North African man, short black hair, neat short beard, tired but kind eyes, grey hoodie under a navy-blue work jacket, jeans, white sneakers

scenes.vo: Ça, c'est Karim. 29 ans. Et dans son téléphone, il y a une idée qui pourrait changer sa vie.
scenes.image_prompt: Karim standing in a logistics warehouse aisle, tall shelving racks in the background, looking at his phone which lights up his face, end-of-day atmosphere
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow zoom in on his face lit by the phone screen, blurred warehouse activity in the background, subtle breathing

scenes.vo: Chaque soir, après l'entrepôt, il ouvre ses notes. Son projet d'application. Deux ans qu'il le peaufine.
scenes.image_prompt: Karim sitting at a small kitchen table at night, warm lamp light, holding his phone showing notes and app sketches, a pushed-aside dinner plate on the table
scenes.motion_prompt: Static camera slightly high angle, he scrolls through his notes with his thumb, warm lamp light flickers softly

scenes.vo: Et chaque soir… il le referme. Parce que Karim n'a personne. Pas de développeur. Pas d'investisseur. Personne à qui en parler.
scenes.image_prompt: Same kitchen, Karim has put the phone face down on the table, head resting on his hand, empty gaze, dark empty apartment around him
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow dolly out revealing the empty silent apartment around him, he sighs, shoulders drop slightly

scenes.vo: Ses collègues ? Ils rigolent. « Toi, une appli ? Redescends, Karim. »
scenes.image_prompt: Warehouse break room, two coworkers in work jackets laughing and elbowing each other, Karim standing apart holding a coffee cup with a forced smile
scenes.motion_prompt: The two coworkers laugh, Karim lowers his eyes toward his coffee, slight slow zoom on him

scenes.vo: Alors l'idée dort. Et le pire, ce n'est pas d'échouer. C'est de ne jamais essayer.
scenes.image_prompt: Night, Karim lying on his bed in dim light, eyes open staring at the ceiling, blue city light coming through window blinds casting striped shadows
scenes.motion_prompt: Fixed camera above the bed, he blinks slowly, the blind shadows shift almost imperceptibly

scenes.vo: Jusqu'au soir où Karim découvre Nour Meet. Des développeurs. Des entrepreneurs. Des gens comme lui… qui cherchent des gens comme lui.
scenes.image_prompt: Same bedroom but the mood shifts, Karim's face lights up looking at his phone displaying a clean app interface with professional profiles, warm golden light glowing on his face
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow zoom in, his eyes widen with hope, he sits up, the warm golden light from the screen grows brighter

scenes.vo: Un profil. Un message. Une visio.
scenes.image_prompt: Karim on a video call on a laptop with a smiling young developer wearing glasses and a headset, both animated and engaged, bright energetic mood
scenes.motion_prompt: Both characters talk enthusiastically on the video call, hand gestures, Karim smiles openly

scenes.vo: Trois semaines plus tard, Karim ne referme plus ses notes. Il construit. À deux.
scenes.image_prompt: The same kitchen table transformed: open laptop showing an app mockup, notebooks, colorful sticky notes, Karim focused and smiling, bright daylight
scenes.motion_prompt: Gentle lateral tracking shot, he types on the keyboard then raises a discreet fist looking at the screen

scenes.vo: Ton associé existe. Il ne sait juste pas encore que tu existes. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
